feeding_claim.verbatim: 100% grass-fed AND grass-finished beef year round.

notes: Checked the farm's online store pages (first order page and about page); wandafarms.com itself was not fetched. Cattle are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished on daily rotated pasture, stockpiled grass and the farm's own hay, never grain; pigs and chickens get non-GMO grain and broilers are moved daily on grass. Sells online with Tuesday and Wednesday home delivery, farm pickup and a farm store at 17419 Hebron Rd, and links a farmers markets page with no markets named. Offers quarter, half and whole beef and half and whole hogs. Says it ships across the Midwest with no states named, so ships_to is empty. The store links a Farm Partners page that was not read, so some items may come from other farms.
